reason: NONE. The first things I saw were $29.99 for 30 servings and zero reviews, then the 'Every batch lab-tested' line with the QR code. The QR is a nice touch, but I don't buy anything without hundreds of reviews, and this costs about $1 a serving when Nature Made or Double Wood are $0.20-0.40.
objection: A brand with no reviews at three to five times the price per serving. I read the 1-star reviews first for pill size, stomach upset and fake dosing, and there is nothing to read yet.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred verified reviews with few complaints about stomach or capsule size, plus a batch report I can actually open that matches the 200 mg on the box, and a lower price per serving.
